name: Orange Minimal / 暖橙活力几何
styleGuide: Warm business/creator explainer language: paper-like neutral backgrounds, flat geometric blocks, a single saturated orange focal accent, bold Inter typography, numbered badges, simple timelines, clean charts. Friendly, direct, structured; not luxurious or cinematic. Orange identifies the key number/node/bar/banner; everything else stays black/white/gray/warm neutral. Motion is clear and rhythmic: slide-up text, left-to-right block reveals, staggered node pops, simple fade/translate exits. Avoid gradients, heavy glow, dark tech atmosphere, ornate serif editorial, over-decorated cards.

termLabel.animation: soft fade-in 0.8s + 10px rise; badge slight scale; fade-out 0.6s

chain.animation: nodes appear top-to-bottom, orange arrows draw down
